item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, and an airmobile brigade of the AFU close to Rubezhnoye, Metallovka, and Berezhnoye in Kharkov region. 💥 In Sumy region, formations of three mechanised brigades of the AFU were hit near Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 165 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one radar station. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Rubtsy, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic) and Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations. 📍 Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30269

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, and an airmobile brigade of the AFU close to Rubezhnoye, Metallovka, and Berezhnoye in Kharkov region.
💥
In Sumy region, formations of three mechanised brigades of the AFU were hit near Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 165 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one radar station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Rubtsy, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic) and Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Groups' units inflicted losses on formations of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Cherevkovka, and Druzhkovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 165 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 24 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements engaged manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Krivorozhye, Belozerskoye, Novopavlovka, Varvarovka, Novodonetskoye, Malotaranovka, Krinitsy, and Starovarvarovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚫 Isolated, trapped, eliminated Servicemen of the 15th Guards Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade and 1437th Motorised Rifle (Assault) Regiment spoke about how the enemy's defences we
item.description: 🚫 Isolated, trapped, eliminated Servicemen of the 15th Guards Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade and 1437th Motorised Rifle (Assault) Regiment spoke about how the enemy's defences were broken in Sergeyevka . ❌ After cutting off supply routes of the militants and depriving them of the ability to use firepower, Russian servicemen began to accumulate manpower for the assault. ▫️ The guys, acting in small groups, crossed an open terrain, rivers, swamps and a barbed wire under the cover of 'eyes' in the sky. Reconnaissance drones adjusted assault detachments, warning about the danger in time. 💥 During the assault of Sergeyevka, the tactics of total suppression of the enemy's firepower using UAVs, artillery, and aviation were used . The enemy could not withstand such pressure: he dropped his weapon, left his dugouts, and ran away. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and facilities of Ukraine’s port i
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and facilities of Ukraine’s port infrastructure, as well as vessels used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following facilities in Kharkov were hit : ▫️ the Epicentr logistics centre, where dual‑use products are stored to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▫️ a distribution centre that provides storage and distribution for military and dual‑use cargo for the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▫️ the Vasishchevo logistics terminal , used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine to store military equipment and dual‑use products. 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship that was delivering supplies to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine to the port of Chernomorsk was damaged at sea . 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
